_doc: Cleo beta UI string catalogue (M3-03, ROUND-3 gap #8). Source of truth for interface copy; published as beta/assets/i18n/<locale>.json. Place names, record write-ups and source names are DATA, never in a catalogue and never machine-translated. A locale is offered in the switcher only when its file sets "reviewed": true (a human reviewer signed it).

strings.city.how.p: Every place is recommended by named sources (review-aggregator star ratings never count as the recommender), pinned to its door from a published coordinate, and status-checked. Closed places stay, flagged, so you know they’re gone.
strings.city.how.t1: The places to plan a visit around — graded within each area, not across the city.
strings.city.how.t2: Strong picks, worth going out of your way for.
strings.city.how.t3: For the curious: smaller, odder, more local.
strings.city.how.order: Within each area, places are ordered by tier, then by number of named sources — never by popularity. Numbers on the cards match the pins on the map. No ratings, prices or opening hours are shown, because the guide doesn’t hold verified ones.
